notes.title: Trust or Distrust?
notes.content: [p]You wake up trapped. You don't know who controls the simulation or what their intentions are. Every decision opens a different branch; every hidden record can change the trust you place in the characters. Will you choose to trust or distrust? 💭[/p]

notes.title: Get ready for the Steam Next Fest
notes.content: [p]Greetings, gamers and digital detectives! 󰡸 In [b]The Visitor Effect[/b], every choice matters and each dialogue brings you closer—or further away—from the truth 🔍 This October, during Steam Next Fest, you’ll get the chance to experience this intense adventure for yourself 👾[/p]

notes.title: Mystery notes
notes.content: [p]Hello to all mystery lovers :)[/p][p]The secret notes you find in the game are key to understanding the hidden story behind the simulation 📝 Each one can change your perspective. Have you come across one that made you question everything?[/p]

notes.title: Too many bugs!
notes.content:
[p]We’ve got a small collapse in the game, you can see it in the trailer. Do you know which of all the clips (there are quite a few) it shows up in?

Bugs and glitches in the simulation! Just like with the collapse, in other parts you’ll need to spot the mistakes the scientist made in order to… escape? Or maybe we don’t want to escape? Honestly, no idea. 

As a dev I’m not sure what to do anymore—should I take care of the bugs or not?[/p][p][/p][p]Cheers![/p]

notes.title: Story vs Playability
notes.content: [p]Hello, digital explorers! 🌌 This game is a real rollercoaster of emotions, mixing clever puzzles with a storyline that pulls you in from the very beginning 📜 What’s impressed you the most so far—the story or the gameplay?[/p]

notes.title: Hey! The developer here
notes.content:
[p]Hi! I am the developer of [b]The Visitor Effect: Not an experiment[/b], I am struggling creating daily content and engaging people, I know the game visuals are not the most attractive and that I should create a better trailer, but I am sure players will enjoy the demo and the complete game.

I was wondering what would you like to see here in the steam community, would you like to see more game content, some curiosities about the game, some gamedev related things? You choose!

I will be happy to see some interaction hehe, now I am going to translate this post to 3 different languages, bye.[/p]

notes.title: A Lie
notes.content: [p]Players and friends, the best part of The Visitor Effect is that every decision matters because there are multiple possible endings 🎭[/p][p]Do you like it when choices change the story, or do you prefer more linear paths?[/p][p]Here, every step counts—and that adds a lot of depth to the experience. What’s your dream ending?[/p]

notes.title: Hello World
notes.content:
[p]Hey Steam gamers! 🎮
[/p][p]In The Visitor Effect, you step into the shoes of R3D, an alien robot trapped in a maze-like simulation with no clear way out 🤖[/p][p][/p][p]Every decision you make could open new doors—or trap you even further.[/p][p]Are you ready to uncover the truth? 🔍[/p]

notes.title: A little bit about Narrative
notes.content:
[p]Dear friends, the narrative of The [b]Visitor Effect[/b] is a labyrinth of secrets and mysteries 🔍

Every character has hidden motivations, and to move forward, you'll need to pay close attention to the dialogues and uncover secret notes that could change everything.

Are you the kind of player who reads every clue to catch every detail? It shows here.[/p]

notes.title: Handmade Puzzles
notes.content:
[p][b]Hello, pixel explorers![/b][/p][p]How are your puzzle-solving skills? 🧩
[/p][p]In [b][i]The Visitor Effect[/i],[/b] we’ve crafted a bunch of handmade puzzles designed to reward clever thinking and keep you on the edge of creativity.[/p][p][/p][p]We’re sure they’ll get your brain working—what do you say? 🤯✨[/p]

notes.title: The Awakening
notes.content: [p]Hello friends and minstrels![/p][p][/p][p]In [b]The Visitor Effect[/b], you wake up as [b]R3D,[/b] an alien robot trapped in a very strange simulation. 🤖[/p][p][/p][p]You don't know who’s controlling you or why, and every step you take could bring you closer to the truth—or deeper into the lie.[/p][p][/p][p]How far would you go to find the way out?[/p][p][/p][p]This game has a gripping story because… Nothing is what it seems![/p]
